# `returning-local-slice`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a returned slice that points into a local array.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The array's storage expires at function return, leaving the caller with a
dangling slice.

## When it fires

It applies when the returned slice and local backing array can be connected by
binding identity: a range slice of the array, the result of
`std.fmt.bufPrint`, `bufPrintZ`, `bufPrintSentinel`, `std.mem.print` or
`printSentinel` formatting into it, the `buffered()` bytes of a
`std.Io.Writer.fixed` writer over it, or a binding, `if` branch or labeled
block result holding one of those. Indexing an element, reading `.len`,
dereferencing with `.*`, passing the slice to another call and copying it are
not reported. Arrays in `comptime var` declarations, `comptime { ... }` blocks
and functions with only comptime parameters are interned at compile time and
are skipped.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn name() []const u8 {
    var buf: [16]u8 = undefined;
    buf[0] = 'a';
    return buf[0..1];
}
```
